assessment.existingConsoleWarning: Identical invalid footer SVG path diagnostic in baseline and production.

conclusions: The latest higher TBT is directly attributable in Lighthouse long-task data to retained GSAP animation work and page initialization, rather than larger JavaScript payloads.

GSAP blocking portions increased from 409 ms to 567 ms (+158 ms). The after run also attributes 144 ms to index.min.js and 97 ms to function.min.js; before counted 49 ms from the now-unloaded YTPlayer and 7 ms from jQuery. These account exactly for 465 ms before and 808 ms after.

Main-thread Style & Layout rose 456 ms, Script Evaluation rose 304 ms, while Script Parsing & Compilation fell 16 ms. Retained GSAP, ScrollTrigger and shared function initialization dominate the additional CPU.

Local JavaScript transfer fell 600703 bytes to 405977 bytes (32.4% smaller), and local script requests fell 17 to 12. The same 44147-byte Elfsight platform script and same Google Fonts payloads appeared in both captures. No Elfsight URL appears among reported bootup or long-task contributors; the reports provide no direct evidence that the widget dominates the regression.

Moving inline code to external deferred files changes task attribution and startup batching. index.min.js contains existing navbar relocation and FAQ initialization; its newly named 194 ms long task should not be described as 194 ms of newly added logic.

These single runs show a real higher measured blocking total, but do not isolate whether changed startup scheduling or machine/rendering variance caused the extra animation/layout cost. Do not present memory or third-party timing as a proven explanation.

LCP still improved 39.933 s to 21.200 s, while the homepage aggregate score decreased 45 to 40. Further splitting/batching animation setup might reduce blocking but could alter animation timing, so no website changes or additional benchmarks were made during diagnosis.

home_execution_experiment.decision: Retain the original body-end library execution mode: the one targeted trial improves Performance40 to45 and TBT808ms to539ms. Extracted Home feed/page scripts remain deferred. Appearance geometry and all normal controls/widget observers passed at all four widths. The remaining TBT539ms is higher than baseline465ms; report it candidly. No source code, animations, script ordering or other pages were changed by QA.

loadingState.controls: The original opaque overlay is forced visible after load and only its ring rotation is frozen. Non-loader images and remote font stylesheets are omitted from this isolated loading-state comparison; production is unchanged.

limitations: Stable screenshots disable animations/transitions, finish GSAP animations, force active swiper slide zero, hide the custom cursor, reveal WOW elements, complete image decoding, and block live Elfsight reviews. These controls are identical on both copies and do not modify production source.

All pages already contain one malformed inline footer SVG path that emits a browser console error; the optimization preserves its original rendering. No new JavaScript exceptions, HTTP404s, or failed network requests occurred in final captures.

The contact form backend form-process.php is absent from the baseline repository. QA intercepted a local submission response solely to exercise existing success/reset handling. Dealer mailto generation was captured without opening email software or sending mail.

Lighthouse13.5 used Edge headless, default mobile form factor and simulated throttling, performance category only. Browser benchmark runs were sequential with no concurrent screenshot/feature workload. The Shop after report explicitly includes js/catalog.min.js.
